changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate datasets and consolidated output descriptions. Kept 'Moral Reasoning Generation' as the primary task since the paper focuses on generating reasoning text alongside classification decisions.
Normalized all F1 variants to 'F1' as per simplification guidelines. The paper uses both macro-F1 and weighted-F1 depending on the dataset.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The LLMs are used for generation only.
The paper does not conduct human evaluations. All evaluations are automated using classification metrics.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on moral reasoning generation and evaluation using structured prompting. While it involves NLG (generating reasoning text), the primary evaluation is classification accuracy rather than text quality. The paper uses standard classification metrics (Accuracy, F1) to evaluate both the binary decisions and the reasoning quality indirectly.
